descriptions: Right ventricle cavity: The blood-filled cavity of the right ventricle in a cardiac short-axis MRI image.
Myocardium: The muscular wall surrounding the left ventricular cavity in a cardiac short-axis MRI image.
Left ventricle cavity: The blood-filled cavity of the left ventricle in a cardiac short-axis MRI image.
